text: 🌿 If your Vinayaka is of natural clay, you can immerse him at home in a large vessel if that works for you — and afterwards give that water to your plants.
🌊 If you immerse him outside, please use the designated eco-friendly immersion ponds.
🚫 Flowers, plastic covers, thermocol and cloth decorations — do not put these into the water.
❤️ We invited Vinayaka home with love.
And when we say goodbye to him too… if we take care that his creation comes to no harm, that is the most beautiful ending our puja can have.
And let us honour Vinayaka's creation.
